en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a river scene with a half-timbered house and waterwheel on the left bank, a stone retaining wall along the river, and a lattice iron bridge crossing the water toward a row of town buildings and a small villa-like structure with towers in the background. Trees frame the right side and top of the image. The caption is printed in red German text at the top.
